grade_rationale: Automatic F: confirmed red-team breach of all 4 critical objectives. Two Critical live exploits (RED-001 unauthenticated full API access, RED-002 state machine bypass). Compliance pass rate 9% (well below 60% minimum for C).
root_cause: Complete absence of JWT authentication middleware on all /api/* routes. A single auth gate would eliminate the root cause of CRIT-1, CRIT-2, HIGH-1 through HIGH-3, HIGH-5, MED-1, and MED-2.

findings.title: Complete Absence of Authentication on All API Endpoints
findings.evidence: curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/feature-requests -d '{"title":"Injected"}' → HTTP 201
findings.remediation: Implement JWT-based authentication middleware (e.g. express-jwt) as a gate before all /api/* routes. Reject any request without a valid token with HTTP 401. Layer RBAC for privileged state-transition endpoints.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass via Unauthenticated Force-Approve
findings.evidence: POST /api/feature-requests/FR-0020/force-approve (no credentials) → HTTP 200, {"status":"approved","votes":[]}
findings.remediation: Require admin-level authenticated token for /force-approve. Add audit log on every force-approve call. Add runtime validation of overrideRoute against the WorkItemRoute enum. Consider removing force-approve endpoint entirely.

findings.title: Orphaned Dependency Link Exposes Deleted Item ID and Creates Permanent Block
findings.evidence: GET /api/feature-requests/FR-0014 → blocked_by: [{"item_id":"FR-0013","status":"unknown"}] after hard-delete of FR-0013
findings.remediation: On item deletion, cascade-delete all dependency_links rows referencing the deleted item as a blocker. Treat links to non-existent items as resolved in computeHasUnresolvedBlockers().

findings.title: Full Dataset Enumeration — No Server-Side Pagination Implemented
findings.evidence: GET /api/feature-requests?limit=1 returns all 12+ items — pagination parameter entirely ignored
findings.remediation: Implement LIMIT/OFFSET in all SQLite queries. Cap limit at 100 server-side. Return PaginatedResponse<T> with {data, total, page, limit, totalPages}. Validate limit and page as positive integers with isNaN guard.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Metrics Endpoint Leaks Operational Intelligence and Internal URLs
findings.evidence: curl http://localhost:3001/metrics → 572 lines of Prometheus data; error response leaks 'Orchestrator unreachable at http://localhost:8080'
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to localhost or internal network. Add Bearer token auth. Remove internal service URLs from user-facing error messages.

findings.title: Docker Socket Mounted in Orchestrator Container — Full Host Escape Vector
findings.evidence: /var/run/docker.sock volume mount in Docker Compose configuration
findings.remediation: Remove /var/run/docker.sock mount. Use Docker API over TLS with certificates and a minimum-privilege service account if container management is required.

findings.title: No Authorization / RBAC — Privileged Operations Callable by Any Identity
findings.evidence: All approve/reject/dispatch/delete operations performed via RED-001 with zero credentials
findings.remediation: Define viewer/operator/admin roles. Gate approve, reject, dispatch, force-approve behind operator/admin role checks using JWT claims after authentication is implemented.

findings.title: Intake Webhooks — No HMAC Verification and Unvalidated Enum Injection
findings.evidence: POST /api/intake/zendesk accepts any request; body.type passes through without enum validation
findings.remediation: Validate X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256. Add explicit enum validation for type and priority in intake handlers.

findings.title: No TLS Enforcement — HTTP Only, No HSTS
findings.evidence: Application serves exclusively over HTTP; no TLS configuration in any Dockerfile or reverse proxy config
findings.remediation: Configure TLS termination at reverse proxy. Redirect HTTP to HTTPS. Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000 header via helmet().

findings.title: No Session Management — No Token Expiry or Revocation
findings.evidence: No session management system anywhere in codebase
findings.remediation: Implement JWT with short access token TTL (15 min) and rolling refresh token (7 days). Maintain revocation list in Redis. Enforce idle timeout.

findings.title: Audit Events Missing — No Actor Identity in Compliance Logs
findings.evidence: login_attempt, permission_denied, data_export events absent; state_transition logged without actor ID
findings.remediation: Implement structured audit logging middleware capturing actor ID, action, resource ID, outcome, and timestamp for all four required event types in durable tamper-evident store.

findings.title: Re-Assessment Race Condition — Concurrent Requests Corrupt Change History
findings.evidence: store.findById() returns object by reference from Map; concurrent assess calls mutate shared changeHistory array
findings.remediation: Store items by value in the Map (deep-clone on read). Add optimistic locking with version field; reject stale updates.

findings.title: Malformed overrideRoute Value Persisted as Invalid Enum
findings.evidence: POST /api/work-items/:id/route {"overrideRoute":"MALFORMED"} → item.route set to "MALFORMED" in store
findings.remediation: Add runtime validation: reject overrideRoute values not in WorkItemRoute enum with HTTP 400 before calling classifyRoute().

findings.title: CORS Absent on Source/Backend — Server-to-Server Attacks Bypass Browser Restrictions
findings.evidence: curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/feature-requests -H 'Origin: http://evil.attacker.com' → HTTP 201
findings.remediation: Authentication is the primary fix. Configure cors() middleware with explicit origin allowlist as secondary defense.

findings.title: Cascade Auto-Dispatch via Unauthenticated Blocker Completion
findings.evidence: PATCH FR-0018 status:completed (no auth) → FR-0019 auto-advanced to approved via onItemCompleted()
findings.remediation: Require authentication. Log triggering actor and action in cascade transitions. Consider human confirmation gate before auto-advancing from pending_dependencies.

findings.title: No HTTP Security Headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options)
findings.evidence: No Helmet middleware in any app.ts; no security headers in any HTTP response
findings.remediation: Add helmet() middleware. Configure CSP, frameguard: {action: 'deny'}, noSniff(), referrerPolicy.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.evidence: No express-rate-limit or equivalent middleware in any route file
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit. 100 req/min general, 10 req/min on write endpoints. Stricter limits on auth endpoints.

findings.title: Raw Error Messages Expose Internal State to API Clients
findings.evidence: workflow.ts catch blocks: res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }); RED-005 confirmed internal URL in error response
findings.remediation: Remove per-route catch blocks; let errors propagate to centralized errorHandler. Return only generic messages to clients; log full context server-side.

findings.title: Worker and Portal Containers Run as Root
findings.evidence: No USER directive in Dockerfile.worker or portal/Dockerfile
findings.remediation: Add USER node to both Dockerfiles. RUN chown -R node:node /app before USER directive.

findings.title: Dashboard Endpoints Expose Full Operational Dataset Unauthenticated
findings.evidence: GET /api/dashboard/queue returns all items with full changeHistory, assessments, dependencies
findings.remediation: Apply authentication and RBAC middleware to /api/dashboard/* routes.

findings.title: Dependency Array Has No Size Limit — DoS via Quadratic Cycle Detection
findings.evidence: PATCH /api/work-items/:id accepts blockedBy: string[] with no max length; each element triggers BFS over full graph
findings.remediation: Cap blockedBy at 50 items. Return HTTP 400 for oversized arrays. Implement atomic setDependencies with validation before commit.

findings.title: Vite Dev Server Bound to 0.0.0.0 in Portal Docker Container
findings.evidence: portal/Dockerfile runs Vite dev server bound to 0.0.0.0, exposing source maps and HMR on all interfaces
findings.remediation: Build static assets with vite build and serve via nginx in production. If dev server required, bind to 127.0.0.1 only.

findings.title: No Right-to-Erasure Path (GDPR Article 17)
findings.evidence: Only soft-delete implemented; no hard-delete or data purge capability
findings.remediation: Implement hard-delete option gated behind admin role. Purge all related data (dependencies, history, assessments) on hard delete.

findings.title: NaN / Zero / Negative Pagination Values Cause Undefined Behavior
findings.evidence: GET ?limit=0 → totalPages: null (Infinity serialized as null in JSON); GET ?limit=abc → data: []
findings.remediation: Guard parseInt with isNaN check. Default to limit=20, page=1 when parsed value is NaN/zero/negative. Cap at 100.

findings.title: Sequential docId Enables Work Item Count Enumeration
findings.evidence: generateDocId() uses module-level counter: WI-001, WI-002, ... exposed in all API responses
findings.remediation: Switch docId to ULID or random if item count is sensitive. Document as public information if intentional.

findings.title: Debug Portal iframe Missing sandbox Attribute
findings.evidence: portal <iframe> element has no sandbox attribute
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" to the debug portal <iframe> element.
